entities.name: Terena
entities.description: Elven queen of the Llanowar elfhame Ruadach, killed in the Phyrexian invasion after ruling 600 years.

entities.name: Ruadach
entities.description: A Llanowar elfhame ruled by Terena.

entities.name: Aedhan
entities.description: Terena's father, poisoned by Beothach and later assassinated by Semion.

entities.name: Beothach
entities.description: Terena's power-hungry, xenophobic brother who poisoned their father; killed by his own death magic.

entities.name: Grenfher
entities.description: Human boy whose family and village were killed by Beothach; Terena's lover.

entities.name: Allenal
entities.description: Half-elven daughter of Terena who now rules as queen.

entities.name: Phyrexian invasion
entities.description: The invasion of Dominaria in which Terena was killed.

events.summary: Terena travels to gather Taradomnu roots to cure her poisoned father and meets Grenfher.
events.quote: she met a human boy named Grenfher

events.summary: Prince Beothach attacks, but Terena's Circle of Protection makes his death magic rebound and kill him.
events.quote: making her brother's death magic rebound back onto himself, killing him

events.summary: Terena and Grenfher make love, a taboo union between elves and humans.
Terena returns to find her father assassinated by Semion.
events.quote: he had been assassinated by Semion

events.summary: Macha senses Terena's pregnancy, letting her take the throne under Ruadach's inheritance law.
events.quote: which allowed her to take the throne for herself and her half-human child

events.summary: Terena is killed in the Phyrexian invasion after ruling 600 years.
events.quote: Terena ruled for 600 years until she was killed in the Phyrexian invasion

relations.quote: the elven queen of the Llanowar elfhame Ruadach
